items.name: Brand Overview
items.price: Sassy Bass is a family-owned collection of Gulf Coast restaurants celebrating good food, great company, and a love for the beach life. Known for its Amazin’ Grill, Island Grill, Chophouse, Pizza, and Market Place, Sassy Bass offers Gulf-caught seafood, hand-crafted burgers, wood-grilled steaks, and tropical cocktails—all served with a fun, friendly island attitude.
